BTS Group Holdings PCL (BTS Group) is a privately owned, multi-industry conglomerate that operates across 3 business platforms; MOVE, MIX and MATCH. Listed on the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET), BTSG is a constituent member of the MSCI Asia Pacific Index, FTSE4Good Index and Dow Jones Sustainability Index (DJSI).
